# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: IRQ 1970 on actions — event hooks.
## COLDWAR | Iraq 1970. Generated by tools/iraq_1970/compile.py.

on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			IRQ = { COLDWAR_IRQ_initialize = yes }
		}
	}
	on_daily = {
		effect = { COLDWAR_IRQ_daily = yes }
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes }
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = { COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_programmes = yes COLDWAR_IRQ_reconcile_situations = yes }
	}
}
